entries.description: Seasonal guest house for lesbian women offering three rooms, situated on an island off the coast of Maine.
entries.raw_text: SEA GNOMES' HOME PO Box 33, Stonington, ME 04681 (207)367-5076. Womyn's Guest House offering 3 rooms at reasonable rates. Seasonal - June thru Sept. Situated on a large island in a small town off the coast of Maine. No bars, no TV, no swimming pool (though there is a lake near). Just a quiet retreat in a beautiful place. We are: 2 lesbians.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in the heart of Mid-Coast Maine, where the mountains meet the sea; farmland
entries.description: Year-round guest house on 18 acres in mid-coast Maine with animals, gardens, and home-cooked meals, welcoming lesbian women and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: LAUREL RIDGE RFD 2 Box 277, Lincolnville, ME 04849 (207)338-1913 (Northport, ME). Laurel Ridge is a guest house for women on 18 beautiful acres of fields and woods in the heart of Mid-Coast Maine, where the mountains meet the sea. Our rates are very reasonable and our guests enjoy comfortable lodging and delicious home-cooked meals. There are domestic and farm animals about the place, as well as veg-etable, herb, and flower gardens. Partial work exchange possible. Open year round. We welcome: non-lesbian women. No drugs or alcohol. We have/are: 18 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods, farmland, camping space, women living and working on the land.

Land address is copied from RFD mailing address. num_residents is left blank because no count is given despite 'women living and working on the land'. entries.land_location_as_stated: in the Blue Mountains; in a private setting in the State Game Lands; woods
entries.description: Vacation cabin on 2 acres in the Blue Mountains welcoming new residents, children, non-lesbian women, and men.
entries.raw_text: HALF MOON PINES c/o Barbara Hart, RD #1 Box 1446, Hamburg, PA 19526 (215)373-5697. Vacation cabin in the Blue Mountains. 3-4 bedrooms which accommodate 7 persons, huge, cozy kitchen and enclosed porch. The cabin is in a private setting in the State Game Lands, one mile down from the Appalachian Trail and a short distance from Blue Marsh Recreation Area and PA Dutch country. Rates $225/week, $150/weekend, $50/day. We welcome: new residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, males, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 acres, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods.

Land address copied from RD mailing address. num_residents left blank because '2 lesbians' is not explicitly paired with a statement of living on the land. entries.description: Lesbian residential community consisting of ten cottages and a cultural and spiritual center with a feminist library, welcoming girl children and non-lesbian women visitors, but restricting ownership and residency to lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: PAGODA 207 Coastal Hwy, St Augustine, FL 32084 (904)824-2970. We are a small lesbian residential community (10 separately owned cottages) with a cultural/spiritual center. Only lesbians may rent or own, but all wommin are welcome to become members and stay in one of our four bedrooms in the center as well as use our feminist library and health food store. Rules in our 2-story center: no smoking, no alcohol on main floor, no cooking or eating of meat, fish or fowl on main floor. We have a BBQ pit and flesh may be eaten elsewhere in building. No pets, no nudity on our property or directly in front of us on the beach. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women visitors. We have/are: 15 resident lesbians, 90 lesbian/nonlesbian members from all over the country, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, ocean, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('small lesbian residential community'). num_residents is 15 ('15 resident lesbians'). Focuses include Lesbian separatism ('Only lesbians may rent or own'), Spirituality/ritual ('cultural/spiritual center'), Archives/cultural work ('feminist library'), and Recovery/substance-free ('no alcohol on main floor'). Accepted groups are Lesbian women, Girl children ('girl children'), and Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women visitors').

entries.land_location_as_stated: located in northwest Michigan a mile from Lake Michigan; facing a sandy beach on Long Lake; woods
entries.description: Wilderness resort on 1 acre with three cabins on Long Lake, seeking investors to create an all-woman community and workshop center, welcoming girl children, boy children under 12, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: LABRYS c/o Nell Wagenaar & Rebecca Clark, Rt 1 Box 257, Honor, MI 49640 (616)882-5994 (4115 M-22). Labrys is an inexpensive, synergetic wilderness resort for women located in northwest Michigan a mile from Lake Michigan. We have three cabins nestled among tall White Pine and Oak facing a sandy beach on Long Lake with dock and boats. We are looking for women to invest in property here. Our dream is to make this end of Long Lake an all-woman community, with a possible campground, a quiet area for geese and heron nesting, more cabins and a community lodge for workshops, etc. Open year round. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children under 12, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 1 acre, 3 cabins, plumbing/electricity, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space ('wilderness resort for women'). Land address copied from Rt 1 rural route mailing address. num_residents is 2 ('2 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'). Boy children accepted conditionally ('boy children under 12'). Workshops/education focus coded based on plans for 'a community lodge for workshops, etc.'

entries.description: Secluded retreat on 14 acres along the Illinois River offering counseling and group retreats, welcoming new residents, children, non-lesbian women, and men.
entries.raw_text: RIVER SPIRIT RETREAT 187 W 19th St, Alton, IL 62002 (618)462-4051 or 653-4349 (retreat) or (314)773-3867 (St Louis). Located Rt 100 North of Kampsville, IL, 1 hr from Alton, 2 hrs from St Louis. River Spirit Retreat is a scenic, secluded retreat for individuals and small groups by the Illinois River. Retreat caters to women, especially lesbians. Open to alternative humanitarian types, counselors or small businesses needing retreat atmosphere. Proprietor is counselor and offers groups and retreats several times a year. We welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, males. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 14 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, camping space, women living part-time and working on the land.
